reporting.primary: All 100 repetitions per condition: the immutable existing 20 plus 80 newly declared repetitions.
reporting.independent_replication: Also report the newly declared 80 repetitions separately.

fixed_conditions: Except for the plotted parameter, preserve N=1000, T=2, dt=0.005, sigma=0.1, sigma_obs=0, the true kernel, initial law, tests, full pairs, trapezoidal quadrature, 1/sqrt(200) row scaling, raw cyclic LASSO and independent-validation selection.
stopping_rule: Run all 80 newly declared triplets at all 20 unique conditions, irrespective of monotonicity or intermediate results. Do not add, remove or select seeds based on outcomes.
failure_policy: Retain every failed job, unconverged candidate, boundary selection, divergent rollout and domain excursion. If any planned value for a condition and metric is missing, its all-run mean and interval are null; never average only successful repetitions.
manuscript_instruction: Do not edit the manuscript in this stage. For later manuscript work, present only the M=17 curves; do not add a four-dictionary comparison or a narrative about selecting M=17 from four dictionaries unless the author explicitly reverses this instruction.
